kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يرتسم (form VIII)
# يَرْتَسِمُ (yartasimu) /jar.ta.si.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# يَرْتَسِمَ (yartasima) /jar.ta.si.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# يَرْتَسِمْ (yartasim) /jar.ta.sim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
